about: TASK-34a12 ground truth for v5 (why on quiz answers only plus the category rule, TASK-34a10/a11), the judgement part. Labelled inside Kiro on 10 Nov 2026 by the lesson-checker persona (.kiro/agents/lesson-checker.md), read-only, over every wrong answer and every answer key on every quiz card of the 34 decks re-recorded for v5 (bench/rerecord.txt), with the same definitions as the v2, v3 and v4 reviews. It is an AI review, not a teacher's. Every distractor NOT listed under 'absurd' was labelled plausible; every key NOT listed under 'keys' was judged correct. scripts/build-distractor-review.ts expands this into bench/distractor-review-v5.json.
definition: absurd = off-topic, physically silly, or no 8–10-year-old would believe it; plausible = a mistake a pupil who has not learnt it yet might really make (it may still be a weak or easy option). Key: correct = the marked answer is the one defensibly right answer; wrong = it is false or another answer is the right one; ambiguous = more than one is defensible, or the question cannot be answered from the lesson's topic.
